description: Two drum voices played from a set of 64 samples, mixed to one output, with a trigger input for each voice

params.text: Changes one setting of the drum picked by the DRUM1 and DRUM2 switch: which of the 64 samples it plays, its pitch, or its decay
In EXCL one drum silences the other so that the two never sound together; in IND each plays on its own
Picks which of the two drums the encoder changes

inputs.text: Carries the CV for the destination picked on the menu, which is the pitch, the decay, the sample number or the volume
A trigger plays the first drum
A trigger plays the second drum

notes: neither drum makes a sound until a trigger arrives at TR1 or TR2; nothing plays on its own
menu: CV to pitch — the CV IN jack sets the pitch of the drum
CV to decay — the CV IN jack sets the decay of the drum
CV to sample — the CV IN jack picks which of the 64 samples plays
CV to volume — the CV IN jack sets the volume of the drum
